scope: Document-only project brief and real interview question review. No application tests/builds, collection, model calls, database, CI, deployment, commit or push.
review_corrections: Create response returns task ID; attempt is selected from detail attempts by sequence. No invented current_attempt_id field.
Heartbeat latency is client RPC round trip; synthetic sampling perturbation is not Drop/CRM end-to-end capacity.
Original Jinja/Memory UI harness and React/FastAPI/Vite UI harness separated.
Workbench required approval scoped to its mode; inbound automatic and assisted paths distinguished.
RAG worker pool activation transaction separated from HTTP-only ordered updates.
Internal TS plain error object separated from external MCP isError. Aggregates do not prove a per-call causal chain.
Revision 8 evaluation weights total 130; not_run denominator and terminal required-failure gates preserved.
limits: 113 counts grouped prompt segments, including unclear prompts/introductory requests; not 113 fully reconstructed unambiguous technical questions.
Six records are six native files, not proof of six independent interviews; S04/S05 may be continuation.

Created-at order is session creation order, not necessarily the first spoken word. Question times use original native timestamps converted to Asia/Shanghai; source HH:MM:SS labels were checked at second precision.
Original ASR has no native speaker labels. Index/time/hash validation does not authenticate speaker identity or historical project claims.
Normalized titles are editorial grouping labels; raw ASR, resumes, job descriptions, account directories and generated app answers are not included in sanitized output.
Historical metrics retain version, workload and denominator; no new runtime claims.
